title: Cuban Missile Crisis
description:
In October 1962, the **Cuban Missile Crisis** brought the world to the brink of nuclear war.

The United States discovered Soviet nuclear missiles being installed in Cuba, just 90 miles from Florida. President Kennedy ordered a naval blockade of Cuba.

After 13 tense days of negotiation, Soviet Premier Khrushchev agreed to remove the missiles in exchange for the U.S. removing missiles from Turkey and a pledge not to invade Cuba.
